title: Tessellating the plane with equilateral triangles

step.script: Equilateral triangles have three equal sides and three sixty-degree angles. Arrange six identical triangles around one vertex.

primitives.meaning: outer boundary of six equilateral triangles

step.script: Six sixty-degree angles make a full turn. The triangles meet without gaps or overlaps.

checkpoint.question: How many equilateral triangles meet at each vertex in this tiling?
checkpoint.expected_gist: Six triangles, because six sixty-degree angles total 360 degrees.

step.script: Attach another matching triangle along an outside edge. Repeating this edge-to-edge pattern covers the entire plane: a tessellation.

ops.meaning: first exposed side of the next equilateral tile
second exposed side of the next equilateral tile
